name: core-staterules
description: StateRules, the own fields a state of the type's Workflow requires or freezes (D56): a transition into a state without a field it requires is vetoed (missing_fields), and a create whose initial state requires one is invalid_instance at the field; while the instance is in a state, an update that clears a required field (required_fields) or changes a frozen one (frozen_fields) is vetoed, a caller's and a behavior's update() alike, the frozen rule lifted by the config's permission alone; absent and null are not held, "" and [] are; "all" freezes every own field; any config change is allowed, an instance that predates a requirement keeping on; Revisions' propose accepts a patch its approve is refused; and the guidance it gives.

s1.name: invoices
s1.description: An invoice an engine runs with the core's Workflow and StateRules and no extension: it is drafted with any fields, sent only with a customer, an amount and its lines, which then stay as they are, and paid or voided with no field left to change but by a caller who may amend it.

s14.name: Workflow
s14.description: A state machine on the instance: a status that starts in the initial state and changes only through transition, along a transition the config lists. A transition may name a permission the caller must hold. A state that no transition leaves is terminal, and a terminal state has an outcome: success, failure or neutral, success unless the config says otherwise. Other instances' blockers, rollups and reactions read it.
s14.summary: Its status is one of draft, sent, paid and void; a new Invoice starts in draft, and status moves only by transition. Terminal, with their outcomes: paid (success) and void (neutral).

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: enteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

vetoes.description: The instance is already in the state the transition names.
The instance is in a terminal state: no transition leaves it.
No transition of the config leads from the instance's state to the one named.
The instance has no status to move from.

shared.s15: Rules per state of the type's Workflow: the own fields an instance must hold to enter a state, and the ones that cannot change while it is in it. A field is held when it is neither absent nor null. A transition into a state while a field it requires is not held is vetoed, and a create whose initial state requires one is refused at the field. An update, a caller's or one a behavior's operation applies, that clears a field the instance's state requires, or changes one it freezes, is vetoed; a caller with the config's permission may change a frozen field. Requires Workflow.

s16.description: A Workflow transition into a state while a field the state requires is absent or null; details names the state and the fields.
An update, a caller's or one an operation applies, that changes a field the instance's state freezes, by a caller without the config's permission; details names the state and the fields.
An update, a caller's or one an operation applies, that clears a field the instance's state requires; details names the state and the fields.

s20.useWhen: Use to page through Invoice instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title, customer, amount, notes or Workflow.status; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's. where: { "Workflow.status": <state> } lists the instances in one of draft, sent, paid or void, and a list of states the instances in any of them.
s20.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
s20.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

expect.name: invoices
expect.description: An invoice an engine runs with the core's Workflow and StateRules and no extension: it is drafted with any fields, sent only with a customer, an amount and its lines, which then stay as they are, and paid or voided with no field left to change but by a caller who may amend it.

instanceBehaviors.description: The instance's behaviors' fields, by behavior name, apart from its own fields

status.description: The state the instance is in.

enteredAt.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

revision.description: The number of the instance's latest revision.

pendingProposals.description: With review in the config, how many of the instance's proposals are pending; absent without review.

behaviors.name: StateRules
behaviors.summary: Entering draft needs title, which stays set while it is draft. Entering sent needs customer and amount, which stay set while it is sent; customer and amount do not change while it is sent. No field changes while it is paid. Only a caller with permission invoices.amend changes a frozen field. A field is held when it is neither absent nor null.

behaviors.name: Revisions
behaviors.description: Immutable revisions of the instance's own fields: one when it is created and one each time they change, numbered 1, 2, 3, ..., read a page at a time or one by its number. With review in its config, a caller can propose a change as a merge patch, citing instances as evidence, and a caller who holds the review permission approves it, which applies the patch as an update, or rejects it; pendingProposals counts the proposals waiting. Deleting the instance deletes its revisions and proposals.
behaviors.summary: Every change of the own fields of a Invoice records a numbered revision of them; behaviors.Revisions.revision holds the latest. A change may also be proposed, and a caller with permission invoices.review approves or rejects it; behaviors.Revisions.pendingProposals counts the proposals waiting.

fields.name: revision
fields.description: The number of the instance's latest revision.

fields.name: pendingProposals
fields.description: With review in the config, how many of the instance's proposals are pending; absent without review.

vetoes.description: propose, approve, reject or listProposals on a type whose Revisions config sets no review.
approve or reject of a proposal that is no longer pending.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create invoices
operations.description: Creates a invoices: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given.

guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Invoice: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one. Give title at create: draft, the state a new Invoice starts in, requires it, and a create without it is refused as invalid_instance, with rule required at the field.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name. A new instance's status is draft.

operations.name: get
operations.title: Get invoices
operations.description: Returns the invoices with the id: its own fields in data, its behaviors' in behaviors.

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

guidance.useWhen: Use when you have the id of the Invoice to read.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to find Invoice instances; call list.
guidance.success: Returns the instance with its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

operations.name: list
operations.title: List invoices
operations.description: Lists invoices instances in creation order, a page at a time: pass a page's next as cursor for the page after it. where keeps the instances whose fields hold the values it gives, a list meaning any of them; a filtered page can hold fewer than limit while next is not null.

next.description: The next page's cursor; null after the last page

operations.name: update
operations.title: Update invoices
operations.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the invoices with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

guidance.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Invoice with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations. Do not use to move Workflow's status, which behaviors.Workflow holds; call transition. While it is draft, do not clear title; while it is sent, do not change or clear customer or amount; while it is paid, do not change any field (a caller with permission invoices.amend may change a frozen field, but not clear a required one).
guidance.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq. A change of the own fields records the next revision.

errors.description: StateRules: An update that clears a field the instance's state requires; details.details.fields lists them.
errors.commonCorrection: Give the field a value instead of clearing it, or move the instance to a state that does not require it first.

errors.description: StateRules: An update that changes a field the instance's state freezes; details.details.fields lists them.
errors.commonCorrection: Leave the field as it is, move the instance to a state that does not freeze it first, or ask a caller with permission invoices.amend.

operations.name: transition
operations.title: invoices: transition
operations.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

from.description: The state the instance was in.

to.description: The state it is in now.

guidance.useWhen: Use to move status from draft to sent or void; from sent to draft, paid or void.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use from paid or void: no transition leaves a terminal state. Do not use to stay where the instance is. Do not move into draft before title holds a value, or sent before customer and amount hold values.
guidance.success: Returns from and to; status holds to from then on, and enteredAt the time of the move.

errors.description: Workflow: No transition leads from the instance's status to the state named; details.allowed lists the states it can move to.
errors.commonCorrection: Read status, then name a state details.allowed lists, or move through one of them first.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance is already in the state the transition names.
errors.commonCorrection: Read status: the instance is already there, so nothing needs to move.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance is in a terminal state: no transition leaves it.
errors.commonCorrection: None: the work has ended. Create a new instance to start again.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance has no status to move from.
errors.commonCorrection: None: an instance without a status cannot move.

errors.description: StateRules: A move into draft or sent while a field it requires is absent or null; details.details.fields lists them.
errors.commonCorrection: Update the instance to give the fields the state requires, then move it.

operations.name: listRevisions
operations.title: invoices: listRevisions
operations.description: Lists the instance's revisions, oldest first, one page at a time.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many revisions; 50 when absent.

next.description: The cursor of the next page; null after the last.

guidance.useWhen: Use to read the instance's revisions, oldest first: each its number and the own fields as that change left them.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not page through them for one revision; call getRevision with its number.
guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null.

operations.name: getRevision
operations.title: invoices: getRevision
operations.description: Reads one of the instance's revisions by its number: the own fields as that change left them. A number the instance has not reached is not_found.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

guidance.useWhen: Use to read one revision by its number, the one a pinned link or a proposal names say: the own fields as that change left them.
guidance.success: Returns the revision; a number the instance has not reached is not_found.

operations.name: propose
operations.title: invoices: propose
operations.description: Proposes a change to the instance's own fields as a JSON merge patch, for a reviewer to approve or reject. The patch must change the instance and leave it valid; nothing changes until a reviewer approves it.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

evidence.description: Instances the proposal cites, for the reviewer: each one must exist and the proposer must be able to read its schema, and a revision must be one it has had, of a schema that composes Revisions. They are kept as given; a later change of an instance cited leaves them as they are.

revision.description: The revision of it the proposal rests on.

schema.description: The schema of the instance cited.

patch.description: A JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) of the instance's own fields.

base.description: The instance's revision when it was proposed.

id.description: The proposal's number on the instance: 1, 2, 3, ...

guidance.useWhen: Use to propose a change of the own fields, as a JSON merge patch, for a caller with permission invoices.review to approve. evidence cites instances the proposer may read, each optionally at a revision it has had.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change the instance at once; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the pending proposal with its id and its evidence; the instance does not change until it is approved.

operations.name: approve
operations.title: invoices: approve
operations.description: Approves a pending proposal: applies its patch to the instance as an update, whose checks run, and records the revision it makes. Needs the review permission.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

proposal.description: The id of the pending proposal.

revision.description: The instance's revision after the approval.

guidance.useWhen: Use to apply a pending proposal; it needs permission invoices.review, else the call is forbidden.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not approve a proposal whose patch breaks the rules of the instance's state: propose accepts it, and approve is refused.
guidance.success: Returns the proposal, approved, with the revision its patch made.

errors.description: Revisions: approve or reject of a proposal that is no longer pending.
errors.commonCorrection: Read the proposal with listProposals: someone has already settled it.

errors.description: StateRules: An update that clears a field the instance's state requires; details.details.fields lists them.
errors.commonCorrection: Give the field a value instead of clearing it, or move the instance to a state that does not require it first.

errors.description: StateRules: An update that changes a field the instance's state freezes; details.details.fields lists them.
errors.commonCorrection: Leave the field as it is, move the instance to a state that does not freeze it first, or ask a caller with permission invoices.amend.

operations.name: reject
operations.title: invoices: reject
operations.description: Rejects a pending proposal; the instance does not change. Needs the review permission.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

proposal.description: The id of the pending proposal.

guidance.useWhen: Use to turn a pending proposal down, with an optional reason; it needs permission invoices.review, else the call is forbidden.
guidance.success: Returns the proposal, rejected; the instance does not change.

errors.description: Revisions: approve or reject of a proposal that is no longer pending.
errors.commonCorrection: Read the proposal with listProposals: someone has already settled it.

operations.name: listProposals
operations.title: invoices: listProposals
operations.description: Lists the instance's proposals, oldest first, one page at a time; with state, only those in it.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

cursor.description: The next of the previous page.

limit.description: At most this many proposals; 50 when absent.

next.description: The cursor of the next page; null after the last.

guidance.useWhen: Use to read the instance's proposals, oldest first, each with the evidence it cites; with state, only the pending, approved or rejected ones.
guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null.
